import sys

def solve() -> None:
    data = list(map(int, sys.stdin.buffer.read().split()))
    it = iter(data)
    N = next(it)
    Q = next(it)

    deg = [0] * (N + 1)
    adj = [set() for _ in range(N + 1)]
    isolated = N
    out_lines = []

    for _ in range(Q):
        t = next(it)
        if t == 1:
            u = next(it)
            v = next(it)
            if deg[u] == 0:
                isolated -= 1
            if deg[v] == 0:
                isolated -= 1
            deg[u] += 1
            deg[v] += 1
            adj[u].add(v)
            adj[v].add(u)
        else:  # t == 2
            v = next(it)
            if deg[v] > 0:
                isolated += 1
            for w in list(adj[v]):
                adj[w].remove(v)
                deg[w] -= 1
                if deg[w] == 0:
                    isolated += 1
            adj[v].clear()
            deg[v] = 0
        out_lines.append(str(isolated))
